fullDescription: Warm cream-and-ink editorial footer with a Fraunces serif wordmark, ember accents, a newsletter band, four serif link columns, and a status-pill legal bar.
prompt: {"style": "Warm editorial print palette: cream #F4EFE4 (top context slice), paper #FBF8F0 (newsletter band), deep ink #1A1712 (the footer body) with cream #F4EFE4 text. Accents are ember orange #C2410C with a lighter ember #F08A4B for section eyebrows and a rust #9A3412 hover; muted browns #6B6253 and #4E4738 for fine print, sand #E7DFCD edges. Fonts (Google Fonts): Fraunces for the display wordmark and the newsletter headline (optical-size serif, weight 600), Newsreader for serif body, eyebrows, links and italics, Inter for the sans UI base. Mood is literary and tactile: a faint radial dot grain overlay, hairline rules, italic 'est. 2026' and 'no. 218' editorial flourishes, and an animated underline-reveal on every link. No neon, all warmth.", "summary": "Build a frameless, full-bleed editorial magazine-style website footer with a warm paper palette, a serif wordmark, a newsletter capture band, four link columns, social chips, and a status-pill legal bar.", "special_notes": "Frameless: no browser chrome, no device mockup, no card around the whole thing, the footer is the artifact and bleeds full width. Bands are full-bleed with content constrained to a centered 1240px container. Use the faint radial-dot grain only on the light bands for paper texture. Keep all text WCAG-legible: cream-on-ink body at high opacity, muted browns reserved for fine print on light surfaces. Strictly warm editorial palette, absolutely no generic indigo or violet slop, no purple gradients. Honor reduced-motion for the underline and hover transforms.", "layout_and_structure": "Frameless, full-width, three stacked full-bleed bands, each with an inner max-width 1240px container (px-6 / md:px-10). Band 1 (cream): a mini masthead with quote-icon logo + nav + ember 'Start free' pill on a top hairline, then a slim editorial context row ('From the library, no. 218' / 'Browse all 1,400 design prompts'). Band 2 (paper, bordered top and bottom): the newsletter capture, a 12-col grid where a 7-col statement (ember eyebrow, large Fraunces headline, serif subcopy) sits beside a 5-col email form. Band 3 (ink, the footer proper): a 12-col grid where a 5-col brand block (40px serif wordmark + vertical divider + italic 'est. 2026', a serif tagline, and a 'Follow along' social row) sits beside a 7-col link nav. A bottom hairline separates the legal bar. Responsive reflow: desktop (1280) brand 5-col beside 4 link columns; tablet (768) link columns become a 2x2 grid with the brand stacked above; mobile (390) everything stacks single-column, link sections pair into 2 columns so every link stays visible (no accordions, no content loss). The legal bar is flex-row on lg and stacks on smaller screens.", "special_ui_components": ["Newsletter form: a coffee #2A251C rounded-2xl pill-shell with soft drop shadow holding an inline email input (paper text, faded placeholder, ember focus ring) and an ember 'Subscribe' button that darkens to rust on hover; below it an italic trust line ('No spam. 11,300 designers already read it.'). Social row: four 44px letterpress chips (X, GitHub, Discord, YouTube) on a warm-charcoal #221E16 surface with inset highlight, that lift -3px and fill ember on hover. Legal bar: copyright, a Terms/Privacy/Cookies/Licenses link cluster, an emerald status pill ('All systems operational' with a live green dot), and a 'Back to top' link with an arrow that nudges up on hover. Every link uses a left-to-right hairline underline-reveal animation."]}
